Safety Precautions
Issue a work permit approved by the station Operations Department
Tools and Equipment Used
Insulating plastic gloves, Avometer
New contactor, identical to the faulty one in terms of connection points and connection time

Ordinary screwdriver 3 × 100 mm, ordinary screwdriver 6 × 150 mm

Procedures to be Carried Out
Inspect the control circuit of the electric feed pump 2, No. (MK169-1201) | 1.
Test the contactor (d2) by isolating one terminal of the 110 V DC supply and test the points (1, 2), (3, 4), (5, 6), (7, 8); determine which points have a bad contact, and test the operation of the timer for connecting points (7, 8). | 2.
Place the pump switch in the
If the switch lamp is not lit, check that 110 V DC is reaching
Make a short circuit across points (7, 8) and observe the appearance of the Pump Off signal | 5.
If the signal does not appear, check that 110 V DC is reaching points (7, 8) | 6.

uncertain_terms.note: The source file has no document title block (no equipment / issued-to / approval-date rows); only a one-cell title table survives. The approval paragraph is also truncated mid-phrase ('ومنسق الشركة للـ').
Source safety-precautions cell is truncated ('إصدار أمر شغل معتمد من قسم التشغيل بالمح'); rendered as 'Issue a work permit approved by the station Operations Department'.

Steps 3 and 4 of the procedure table have no step numbers in the source and are truncated mid-sentence ('ضع مفتاح الطلمبة فى وضع' / 'تأكد من وصول جهد 110 فولت تيار مستمر'); rendered literally as incomplete sentences.
Source 'واختيار اشتغال المؤقت' evidently means 'and test the operation of the timer' (اختيار = typo for اختبار); rendered as 'test the operation'.
Source test-wire size reads '2 20X مم'; rendered as '2 × 20 mm' as printed — the size is suspect.
Source 'بنسه ببوز مبطط' rendered as 'flat long-nose pliers'.
